description: Progressive-enhancement guided tour. Renders as an in-page step list without JS; enhances to an interactive spotlight overlay with the web component.

attributes.name: data-title
attributes.description: Tour name; the accessible name of the tour card

attributes.name: data-mode
attributes.description: Skip behaviour: passive and active allow skipping (Skip button, Escape, backdrop click); forced removes all three. Action gates come from each step's data-action, not the mode

attributes.name: data-persist-key
attributes.description: Storage key override (defaults to page path)

attributes.name: data-spotlight-padding
attributes.description: Pixel padding around the spotlight; overrides the --tour-spotlight-padding token

attributes.name: data-label-step
attributes.description: Step counter template; {n} and {total} are replaced

attributes.name: data-label-close
attributes.description: Skip button text on the last step

attributes.name: data-label-finish
attributes.description: Next button text on the last step

attributes.name: data-label-nav
attributes.description: Accessible name of the card's button group

attributes.name: data-label-ready
attributes.description: Announced when a step's required action completes

attributes.name: data-complete
attributes.description: Present after tour finishes or is skipped

structure.description: Individual tour step — contains heading and description

childAttributes.name: data-target
childAttributes.description: CSS selector for the element to highlight

childAttributes.name: data-placement
childAttributes.description: Preferred card side; inline-start/inline-end follow the text direction. Flips when there is no room

childAttributes.name: data-action
childAttributes.description: Required user action on the target before Next is enabled (custom: the page dispatches tour:action on the <page-tour>)

childAttributes.name: data-action-hint
childAttributes.description: Instructional text shown while waiting for action

childAttributes.name: data-skippable
childAttributes.description: false hides Skip and ignores Escape and backdrop clicks on this step (forced mode already does this for every step)

events.name: tour:action
events.description: Fired when a required action completes

events.name: tour:complete
events.description: Fired when last step is finished

events.name: tour:skip
events.description: Fired when user skips the tour

methods.name: start(step?)
methods.description: Start at a step index (default 0). While already running, moves to that step instead

methods.name: next()
methods.description: Advance; ignored while the step's action gate is waiting. On the last step, completes the tour

methods.name: goto(index)
methods.description: Jump to a step (0-based); steps whose target is missing are skipped

methods.name: skip()
methods.description: Skip the tour (fires tour:skip); ignored when the current step is not skippable

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Clear persisted progress and reset data-step to 0

cssProperties.name: --tour-spotlight-ring
cssProperties.description: Spotlight ring and active pip colour (default var(--color-primary))

cssProperties.name: --tour-spotlight-padding
cssProperties.description: Space between the target and the spotlight edge (default 8px)

cssProperties.name: --tour-card-offset
cssProperties.description: Gap between the spotlight and the card

cssProperties.name: --tour-z-index
cssProperties.description: Stacking level of the backdrop and spotlight
